capacity_metric: largest tested stream level meeting the latency budget
memory_semantics: sum of per-worker process peak RSS; not a simultaneous process-tree peak
limitations: Synthetic deterministic input is a runtime load fixture, not a speech-quality cohort.
Each concurrent stream is an independent worker process; it does not claim SDK in-process thread scaling.
The result is capped at 16 tested streams and does not establish capacity above that level.
